title: Give an AI agent access
introCreate: {agent} wants to create a Steerpost account for {email} and work in it for you.
introExisting: {agent} asked for access to your Steerpost account {email}.

can.read: See your connected accounts and posts.
can.schedule: Schedule posts at least 5 minutes ahead. They publish at that time without another check.
can.connect: Connect networks with credentials you give it, without asking you each time.

revokeHint: You can revoke its access at any time under Developer.
signInBody: This request is for an existing account. Sign in as {email} to confirm it. You can also refuse it without signing in.
otherUserTitle: You are signed in as someone else
otherUserBody: You are signed in as {current}. This request is for {email}. Sign out to continue.
invalidBody: It may have expired, been used or been refused. Links last 24 hours. Ask your agent to sign up again.
missingTitle: Open the link from the email
missingBody: This page needs the link Steerpost emailed you. If you signed in on the way, open that link again.
doneCreateBody: Your account is ready and {agent} can now work in it.
noPassword: Your account has no password yet. Set one so you can sign in again later.
doneExistingBody: {agent} can now work in your account. You can see and revoke its key under Developer.
declinedBody: The agent's key will never work. You can close this page.
